description: This Java abstract class defines support functionalities for managing layout templates within the OpenMRS system, including retrieving templates by various identifiers and managing associated properties.

classes.name: LayoutSupport
classes.description: An abstract class providing layout template management functions within the OpenMRS project, handling retrieval by various identifiers and storing layout-related properties.

methods.name: getLayoutTemplates
methods.description: Returns the list of layout templates associated with this support class.

methods.name: setLayoutTemplates
methods.description: Sets the list of layout templates for this support class.

methods.name: getDefaultLayoutTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves the default layout template based on the default layout format.

methods.name: getLayoutTemplateByName
methods.description: Finds a layout template by a given name, matching against display name, code name, or country, case-insensitively.

methods.name: getLayoutTemplateByCodeName
methods.description: Finds a layout template by its code name, case-insensitively.

methods.name: getLayoutTemplateByCountry
methods.description: Finds a layout template by its country field, case-insensitively.

methods.name: getLayoutTemplateByDisplayName
methods.description: Finds a layout template by its display name, case-insensitively.

methods.name: getSpecialTokens
methods.description: Returns the list of special tokens associated with layout templates.

methods.name: setSpecialTokens
methods.description: Sets the list of special tokens.

methods.name: getDefaultLayoutFormat
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the default layout format.
